readout_other: fiber photometry (GCaMP6s, jRGECO1a) of CaMKII, PV, VGAT and TH cells; [18F]FDG PET; hippocampal LFP epileptiform spike rate and HFO amplitude
direction_notes: Continuous 200 ms pulses raised activity of both CaMKII and PV cells in hippocampus; the 900 Hz protocol raised PV (inhibitory) activity while suppressing CaMKII activity, reduced hippocampal FDG uptake and suppressed epileptiform spikes in kainate mice.
safety_notes: Thermocouple measurements with the 900 Hz protocol: +0.23 +/- 0.15 C at the focus and +1.2 +/- 0.53 C at the skull (absolute maximum).

exposures.label: Hippocampus (CA1 photometry, PET, and contralateral hippocampus in kainate epilepsy)

timing.protocol_description: Shuffled 200 ms continuous-wave pulses of varying pressure once every 30 s; a 900 Hz protocol (5 s, 20 % duty cycle, 4.5 W/cm2 ISPPA) delivered every 3 min for 30 min in PET and in the kainate model; a 1 Hz control protocol (5 s, 8 % duty cycle) in PET.
The same 900 Hz protocol (5 s, 20 % duty cycle, 4.5 W/cm2 ISPPA) as in the hippocampus, applied while monitoring VGAT+ and TH+ neurons.

exposures.label: Centromedial thalamus (on-target and 3 mm dorsal off-target)

timing.protocol_description: 200 ms continuous-wave pulses delivered on-target or to cortex and skull 3 mm dorsal (off-target); the 900 Hz protocol (5 s, 20 % duty cycle, 4.5 W/cm2 ISPPA) was applied to CaMKII+ CMT neurons.
200 ms continuous-wave pulses of varying intensity delivered in shuffled order to CaMKII+ neurons; intensity values are shown only in figures.

flags.reason: Group sizes vary by experiment (n = 5 to 8, PET n = 5 and n = 3, epilepsy n = 5) and animals may be shared across experiments; no total is stated.
0.62 MPa peak negative pressure and 12.3 W/cm2 ISPPA were measured through an explanted skull at 220 peak volts (device characterisation), not for the 4.5 W/cm2 protocol.

The 4.5 W/cm2 ISPPA of the 900 Hz protocol is not said to be in water or in situ; the Methods describe ISPPA derived from hydrophone pressure through a skull with an assumed brain impedance, but do not tie that to this value.

Pulse duration is not stated; DC/PRF is not computed. Waveform mixes continuous 200 ms pulses and a 900 Hz pulsed protocol (and a 1 Hz, 8 % protocol in PET). The PRF and duty-cycle lists cover the pulsed protocols only. Quote for the lists is the 1 Hz sentence; the 900 Hz / 20 % values are in the sentence quoted for exposures[1].
200 ms from the continuous-wave experiment and 5 s from the 900 Hz and 1 Hz protocols.
Target stated as the centromedial nucleus of the thalamus (CMT); mapped to centromedian_nucleus as nearest term. Fig. 3 caption labels the CMT panel as VTA but the text assigns it to CMT.
Intensities given only in figure; no numeric pressure or intensity in text for these pulses.
Piezoelectric ring from Thorlabs assembled in-house with balsa and magnesium layers; driving electronics (Agilent 33210A, ENI 2100L amplifier) do not set the family.
Off-target stimulation 3 mm dorsal in CMT; PET compared stimulated with unstimulated hemisphere and with a 1 Hz protocol; no powered-off arm.
Off-target (cortex/skull) stimulation response was 55 % of on-target, used to argue audible sound is not substantial; no masking.
Photometry online; PET FDG uptake over 30 min stimulation with scan afterwards; LFP spikes analysed after stimulation.
1 Hz protocol in PET gave no significant FDG increase; 900 Hz is the main protocol.
